# Chemistry that Thinks™.
# Materials that Adapt™.

For nearly 170 years we have mastered the molecular. Today we are mastering the digital. By
integrating AI driven insights with world class manufacturing, Hexion is pioneering a future of
**Chemistry-as-a-Service^{TM}**. A future where we provide chemistry that thinks, materials that
adapt, to make your products and your teams smarter, better, and more efficient.

## At Hexion, we don't just build products, we build legacies.

Our teams and tools span chemical engineering, manufacturing, and material science all under one
roof.

### A foundation built together

Backed by partnerships spanning 50+ years and a top-ten customer roster averaging 25 years of
loyalty, delivering the stability and trust needed to scale with confidence.

### 170 years of Molecular Memory

Combining a century of chemical data with AI-driven insights to predict variables before they hit
your line, preventing problems before they start.

### We win when you win

Engineering custom formulations and actionable data that lower waste, raise margins, and deliver the
“Golden Batch” every single day.

## Our Chemistry-as-a-Service™ is your Unfair Advantage.

### Dynamic Material Intelligence

Build a foundation of material intelligence enabling you to adapt your line and your chemicals to
get the most out of them

### AI-Powered Process Optimization

Optimize your manufacturing setpoints to save costs, enhance throughput, improve quality, and reduce
energy & material use.

### Adaptive Resin Platform

Get resin that is formulated to your specific outcomes by leveraging data and responding to evolving
business priorities and changes in environmental factors.

## Industries we serve

[

### Agriculture

Hexion’s innovative resin technologies enable controlled, slow-release fertilizers that improve
nutrient efficiency, crop yield, and environmental sustainability.

Read our case study

### Agriculture

][42][

### Automotive

Our high-performance resins and adhesives drive innovation in lighter, safer, and more
energy-efficient vehicles.

Read our case study

### Automotive

][43][

### Building Materials

High-performance materials engineered to improve strength, durability, and sustainability in modern
construction applications.

Read our case study

### Building Materials

][44][

### Coatings & Paint

Our advanced monomers enable durable, high-quality coatings with optimized performance and
compliance.

Read our case study

### Coatings & Paint

][45][

### Equipment Solutions

Integrated equipment and process solutions designed to enhance efficiency, reliability, and
performance in industrial operations.

Read our case study

### Equipment Solutions

][46][

### Formalin

Essential formalin solutions produced with a focus on quality, consistency, and responsible
manufacturing.

Read our case study

### Formalin

][47][

### Mining

Our robust systems improve safety, efficiency, and environmental performance in the world’s most
demanding extraction environments.

Read our case study

### Mining

][48][

### Oil & Gas

Hexion chemistry delivers strength and reliability under pressure—enhancing drilling performance,
well integrity, and operational safety.

Read our case study

### Oil & Gas

][49][

### Wood Panels

Innovative resin systems designed to improve panel performance, productivity, and sustainability
across wood-based products.

Read our case study

### Wood Panels

][50]

## Science with Purpose, Sustainability with Soul.

At Hexion, we don’t make empty promises; we drive measurable, year-over-year progress to protect our
environment and empower the professionals who are behind it.

Shrinking Our Footprint,
Not Our Ambition

By prioritizing energy efficiency and circularity, we aim for measurable reductions in emissions and
resource use every single year, even if that means rethinking our legacy formulas from the ground
up.

With you anything is possible

We are looking for the curious, the bold, and the nerds who want to question the status quo. If you
are ready to grow, we provide the safety, well-being, and technical tools to help you reach your
full potential.

## OLIN and HUNTSMAN Announce S-4 Registration Statement in Connection with Planned Merger is
## Effective

Olin Corporation (NYSE: OLN) ("Olin") and Huntsman Corporation (NYSE: HUN) ("Huntsman") announced
that on July 13, 2026, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective the
registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with
the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman. 

[Learn More][78]

## Huntsman to Discuss Second Quarter 2026 Results on July 31, 2026

We will hold a conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss our second
quarter 2026 financial results. Following opening remarks, the call will move into a question and
answer session.

[Learn More][79]

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]
[Watch Video][113]

Find the right Huntsman product for you

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

[View Investor Relations][118]

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries

* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# YOUR DREAMS, OUR CHALLENGE

Since its establishment in 1907, AGC’s core principles have been focused on developing technologies
that make a positive change for the future of our world. Our promise to our customers and
stakeholders is to provide value in everything that we do and to help realise greater achievements.

## [EXCELLENCE IN FLUOROPOLYMERS][150]

As a world-leading manufacturer of fluoropolymers and fluoroelastomers, and number one in ETFE, AGC
Chemicals Europe has been providing solutions for the most demanding technological challenges across
all industries since 1952.

## Corporate Vision

# ‘Chemistry for a Blue Planet’ is about how chemistry can contribute to environmental solutions

This mission is supported by four pillars:

[Safety]

# Safety

‘Safety first’ is the byword at every AGC Chemicals workplace. The safety of the end users of our
products and those who work at our facilities around the world, is at the forefront of everything we
do.

[Security]

# Security

We insist that the products and chemicals we manufacture serve society and give people a sense of
security. We are committed to doing business in a socially responsible way and to earning the trust
of all the stakeholders we deal with.

[Comfort]

# Comfort

We believe that human comfort and convenience are absolutely compatible with environmental
stewardship. Chemistry has the potential to deliver solutions that satisfy both consumer demands and
environmental imperatives.

[Environment]

# Environment

We pride ourselves in delivering safe, sustainable solutions that continue to transform industry
impacts on our environment. We constantly develop new ways to reduce our environmental footprint,
providing products that enable sustainable engineering and greener energy for the planet.

# YOUR DREAMS, OUR CHALLENGE

Since its establishment in 1907, AGC’s core principles have been focused on developing technologies
that make a positive change for the future of our world. Our promise to our customers and
stakeholders is to provide value in everything that we do and to help realise greater achievements.

## [EXCELLENCE IN FLUOROPOLYMERS][150]

As a world-leading manufacturer of fluoropolymers and fluoroelastomers, and number one in ETFE, AGC
Chemicals Europe has been providing solutions for the most demanding technological challenges across
all industries since 1952.

## Corporate Vision

# ‘Chemistry for a Blue Planet’ is about how chemistry can contribute to environmental solutions

This mission is supported by four pillars:

[Safety]

# Safety

‘Safety first’ is the byword at every AGC Chemicals workplace. The safety of the end users of our
products and those who work at our facilities around the world, is at the forefront of everything we
do.

[Security]

# Security

We insist that the products and chemicals we manufacture serve society and give people a sense of
security. We are committed to doing business in a socially responsible way and to earning the trust
of all the stakeholders we deal with.

[Comfort]

# Comfort

We believe that human comfort and convenience are absolutely compatible with environmental
stewardship. Chemistry has the potential to deliver solutions that satisfy both consumer demands and
environmental imperatives.

[Environment]

# Environment

We pride ourselves in delivering safe, sustainable solutions that continue to transform industry
impacts on our environment. We constantly develop new ways to reduce our environmental footprint,
providing products that enable sustainable engineering and greener energy for the planet.

## INDUSTRIAL CHEMICAL SUPPLIERS ACROSS EUROPE AND WORLDWIDE

**East Harbour Group Ltd offers a reliable source of premium, cost-effective materials. Thereby
reducing supply chain risks for its customers.**

As one of the biggest industrial chemical suppliers, we specialise in the distribution of raw
materials and chemicals to manufacturers globally. Our expert team supports businesses with our
cost-effective solutions for raw materials. We are best placed to support your business,
guaranteeing minimal risk and maximum performance.

[ Get A Quote ][5]
[Content Card]
Supplying speciality and industrial chemicals

We supply a vast range of industrial chemicals and specialty materials worldwide, including raw
materials and hazardous chemicals. We operate to UKWA, BIFA, and FTA industry standards.

[Content Card]
Experts in the field

Our team of experts provide a streamlined, efficient service to all of our customers worldwide. Our
relationships, network of global agents and experience enable us to optimise your logistics
solutions. We lower your operational costs, reduce inventory, and streamline your dispatch
processes.

[Content Card]
Cost Effective

We identify and propose optimal and cost-effective solutions for your chemical supply needs by
selecting asset-based providers, on a range of criteria, based on your requirement.

[Content Card]
Safety and Security

With state-of-the-art security measures, you can count on us to deliver products safely and
securely. And with our commitment to the environment, you can rest assured that your products will
be delivered in alignment with environmental best practices.

CONTACT US TO DISCUSS YOUR CHEMICAL SUPPLY REQUIREMENTS ACROSS EUROPE AND BEYOND.

[ Get A Quote Now ][6]

### WHY CHOOSE EAST HARBOUR GROUP?

The industrial chemical supply sector is essential for all branches of industry. With years of
experience, East Harbour Group understands the importance of efficient and cost-effective solutions
for our customers. We operate UKWA, BIFA, and FTA and follow industry best practices to ensure all
our chemical deliveries are fast, safe and secure. Our global network allows us to lower operational
costs and streamline delivery processes, thereby ensuring an optimised chemical supply solution.

[FAQs icon]

## FAQs

How can I contact East Harbour Group to get a quote?

If you wish to discuss your logistics and transportation requirement, simply visit our [Contact
page][7], give us a call at +44 (0)333 242 0100 or email us at [[email protected]][8].

Do we comply with industry standards?

We operate UKWA, BIFA, and FTA and follow industry best practices to ensure all our chemical
deliveries are fast, safe and secure.

Do you supply chemicals outside of Europe?

Yes, we supply a vast range of speciality and industrial chemicals worldwide, including raw
materials and hazardous chemicals.

# Omya ranked #7 globally in chemical distribution

##### Our combined businesses, Omya Specialty Materials and Omya Performance Polymer Distribution,
##### are ranked 3rd in Europe and 7th globally in the 2025 ICIS top 100 chemical distributors
##### listing.

[Read more][248]
[Omya Specialty Materials Hero Image]

# Omya Specialty Materials

##### One-stop shop technical solutions for customers worldwide through the global distribution of
##### minerals and chemicals.

[Learn more about Omya Specialty Materials][249]
[Science Molecule DNA Model Structure, business teamwork concept 270524519]

# Omya Performance Polymer Distribution

##### Your global distribution partner for high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and
##### rubber polymers and additives.

[Discover Omya Performance Polymer Distribution][250]

## Our business units
* [
  
  ## Omya Specialty Materials
  
  Global sales and distribution for a wide range of specialist minerals, pigments, binders,
  additives, and life science ingredients.
  [OSM header]
  ][251]
* [
  
  ## Omya Performance Polymer Distribution
  
  Global distribution of high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and rubber polymers
  and additives.
  [OPPD_Header_image]
  ][252]

## Thinking of Tomorrow

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current
and future generations. Our scientists work closely with customers and partners across the world,
using our Horizon Framework to consider the short, medium and long term issues facing our planet and
society.

[Learn more about innovation][253]

## Omya is a leading global producer of essential minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty
## materials.

[Explore our story][254]

### Technical expertise and application development

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers
laboratory analysis, technical expertise, and application development to customers and partners
globally.

 

We support process efficiencies, formulation optimization, and functionality improvements to
increase performance.

[Learn more about innovation][255]
[Innovation]

## Sustainability is key to our success and that of our customers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on
enhancing our own performance across social, environmental, and economic dimensions, and we are
dedicated to helping our customers achieve their sustainability goals.

 

Our natural mineral solutions are designed to have a low carbon footprint, offering a more
sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

[Learn more][256]
[Sunlight in the green forest]

## Join the Omya team

With 9,000 people employed across more than 50 countries, Omya offers exceptional career
opportunities to talented individuals with the determination to succeed.

 

If you have a passion for minerals and chemistry, and would like to be part of our team, we’d love
to hear from you.

[See our job openings][257]
[Career opportunities at Omya]

At Omya, we take a long-term approach to business, ensuring sustainability and growth for both our

## Trusted by Leading Brands
## Used by Over 2000 Companies

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

    Our Team possess the values and skills that are essential to the service we provide to our

    Our people are the backbone of our business and offer a wealth of knowledge, advice and support

  * [Brand Values][89]
    As an established independent family owned company, we understand the industrial chemicals we
    supply and manufacture are an essential part of your businesses processes.
    
    Our acclaimed industry reputation is built on our core brand values which sets us apart from the
    competition.
    
    We understand industries and use our technical capability, advanced technology and established
    supply chain infrastructure to provide R&D and manufacturing solutions.
  * [History][90]
    Plater Group's Glossop site has had a long and varied history.
    The buildings were originally constructed in 1902, by the Urban Electricity Supply Company, to
    provide power for the new Glossop Tramways. The first tram ran in August 1903 and the last on

## Plater Group is a leading UK chemical supplier, providing high-quality chemical supplies,
## manufacturing services and bespoke solutions to a wide range of industries including
## pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, agriculture, water treatment, coatings, construction and
## electronics.

As a trusted chemicals supplier, we combine global sourcing with advanced in-house capabilities such
as [chemical research and development][98], custom synthesis, [spray drying][99], [toll spray
drying][100], [spray cooling][101], [liquid][102] and [powder blending][103], toll manufacturing and

cost-effective raw materials tailored to exact customer specifications. With ISO-accredited quality
systems, strong partnerships with international producers and a focus on innovation, Plater Group
ensures a reliable chemical supply chain for UK and international markets. From commodity reagents

customers with traceability, flexibility and technical support at every stage

# Knock the door of science and PSIBERG will let you in.

### Pursue. Synchronize. Innovate

[Explore PSIBERG][32]

#### Vision of PSIBERG

Psiberg is a virtual campus for all things science. We provide global education in the latest
scientific concepts, including but not limited to quantum mechanics.

Our way of teaching science simplifies concepts for students. We aim to eliminate the traditional
rote memorization and provide students with topics in a unique way to help them understand easily.

### Sci to Psi

Our project aims to help pursue science knowledge all over the globe and understand new techniques
of science.

### Infographics

Infographics help students to understand the knowledge with ease. All published articles on PSIBERG
are available with relevant CGI.

### Pursue. Synchronize. Innovate

[Explore PSIBERG][32]

#### Vision of PSIBERG

Psiberg is a virtual campus for all things science. We provide global education in the latest
scientific concepts, including but not limited to quantum mechanics.

Our way of teaching science simplifies concepts for students. We aim to eliminate the traditional
rote memorization and provide students with topics in a unique way to help them understand easily.

### Sci to Psi

Our project aims to help pursue science knowledge all over the globe and understand new techniques
of science.

### Infographics

Infographics help students to understand the knowledge with ease. All published articles on PSIBERG
are available with relevant CGI.

Concepts Berg is a separate section for short questions where we try to answer briefly and yet clear
the common misconceptions.

## WHAT OUR CLIENTS SAY ABOUT US

### Arjun Patel

Procurement Lead
We have been sourcing ethyl acetate from Yingtaichem for several production cycles. The consistent
purity of their product has greatly improved the reliability of our blending process. After order
confirmation, their team proactively provided detailed handling and storage guidelines. They also
demonstrated notable flexibility in accommodating a urgent request to reschedule delivery. Their
approach makes them a responsive and reliable partner.

### Khalid Al-Farsi

Product Manager
We got propylene glycol from Yingtaichem for our cosmetic formulations, and we’re thrilled. Its high
purity gives our lotions a smooth, non-greasy texture customers love. They customized a storage plan
for our humid warehouse and followed up friendly to check on us. Total go-to supplier material.

### Karl Hoffmann

CEO
Our bulk order of industrial-grade ethanol from Yingtaichemmet our specifications perfectly . The
product’s stable concentrationmaintains consistent disinfection efficacy throughout our production
facility . The delivery was punctual with secure packaging, and their technical team provided
detailed answers to our compatibility querieswithin the hour .This reliability has made them a
valued partner for our regular supply needs.

### Murat Iskakov

Procurement Manager
We got connected to YingTai Chemical through a referral from one of our existing clients. We’ve
beensourcing 1000 MT of MTBE per month from them , which we mainlyuse as a gasoline blending
component to boost octane rating .Their supply capacity is strong and deliveries are always on time.
Even though it’s a cross-border trade, they’ve been really helpful in smoothing out a lot of the
usual hurdles. The quality has been consistent, and we’ve built a solid trusted relationship — it’s
been a very smooth and positive cooperation.

## WHAT OUR CLIENTS SAY ABOUT US

### Arjun Patel

Procurement Lead
We have been sourcing ethyl acetate from Yingtaichem for several production cycles. The consistent
purity of their product has greatly improved the reliability of our blending process. After order
confirmation, their team proactively provided detailed handling and storage guidelines. They also
demonstrated notable flexibility in accommodating a urgent request to reschedule delivery. Their
approach makes them a responsive and reliable partner.

### Khalid Al-Farsi

Product Manager
We got propylene glycol from Yingtaichem for our cosmetic formulations, and we’re thrilled. Its high
purity gives our lotions a smooth, non-greasy texture customers love. They customized a storage plan
for our humid warehouse and followed up friendly to check on us. Total go-to supplier material.

### Karl Hoffmann

CEO
Our bulk order of industrial-grade ethanol from Yingtaichemmet our specifications perfectly . The
product’s stable concentrationmaintains consistent disinfection efficacy throughout our production
facility . The delivery was punctual with secure packaging, and their technical team provided
detailed answers to our compatibility querieswithin the hour .This reliability has made them a
valued partner for our regular supply needs.

### Murat Iskakov

Procurement Manager
We got connected to YingTai Chemical through a referral from one of our existing clients. We’ve
beensourcing 1000 MT of MTBE per month from them , which we mainlyuse as a gasoline blending
component to boost octane rating .Their supply capacity is strong and deliveries are always on time.
Even though it’s a cross-border trade, they’ve been really helpful in smoothing out a lot of the
usual hurdles. The quality has been consistent, and we’ve built a solid trusted relationship — it’s
been a very smooth and positive cooperation.
